The germinal set always asks for temperature, takes weight as a decimal total gross weight in kilograms, and stores and shows its germinal details even where PIMS does not carry them. Its review leaves out the CPH number and permanent address, and names every species short of what submit needs, a lone species included (c-277).
acceptanceCriteria: In the germinal-products set's review, each species block shows 'Total gross weight' as '<n> kg', a decimal weight such as '12.5 kg' reading back as entered, and 'Number of packages' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-083; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-022)

In the germinal-products set's review, the first block of the first commodity card always shows a 'Temperature' row with the chosen answer (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-085; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-021)

In the germinal-products set's review, a germinal species' identification details read back as a list of each identifier field and its saved value, including the details PIMS does not carry (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-087; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-042)
The live-animals set's review shows none of these germinal rows (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110)

The germinal products set's review is its own copy of the live-animals review: its Addresses card has no 'County parish holding (CPH) number' row and no 'Permanent address' subsection, and nothing it marks as needed before submit asks for additional details, a CPH number or a permanent address (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-016, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-110, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-111, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-125)

In the germinal products review, each selected species short of what submit needs is named, whether one species or several are selected: 'Enter the number of packages for <species>' when it has no count, and 'Enter at least 1 animal identifier for <species>' when it has a count but no entry holding an identifier, with the species name in lower case and the entry linking to that species block (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-057, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-058, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-059; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-110; c-277)
notes: Re-drafted for the 9 October ruling: the germinal content is built in the germinal set's copy of the review (claim 110), not in the live-animals review. Depends on the germinal set's scaffold and its Commodity details and identification rows (keeps inc-017, inc-052's content, inc-176, inc-099), which let a germinal notification be answered, and on the live-animals commodity card and identification rows (inc-104, inc-106), because the germinal review is copied from the live review once those are built (claim 14). Pass 2 combines the germinal read-back, the germinal copy's readiness test and its unfinished-species messages: one page in one feature folder. The live-animals half of the per-species messages is the identification row's (req-879). Its code is the germinal set's copy of check-answers, so it stays in the germinal-products theme.

increments.title: Identification details on the review: heading, animal labels, its own Change link and per-species unfinished messages
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 heads each species' identifier table 'Identification details', labels each animal by species and number, lets the trader change identifiers straight from the review, and, in the live-animals set when more than one species is selected, names each species that is short of a count or an identifier. DR1 parity row inc-150 deferred the per-species marking for a design ruling; Design Release 2.1 supplies it (c-134).
acceptanceCriteria: A live-animal species block's identifier table is headed 'Identification details' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-086; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-159, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-145)

Each row of the table is labelled with the species name and the animal's number, for example 'Felis catus 1', under an 'Animal' column, with one column per identifier field (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-086; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-145)

On an editable review, Identification details has its own Change link opening the animal identification page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-088; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-145)

In the live-animals set, with more than one species selected and identifiers required, a species with no count is named 'Enter the number of animals for <species>', with the species name in lower case, and the error summary entry links to that species block (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-056, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-057, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-058; c-134)

In the live-animals set, with more than one species selected and identifiers required, a species with a count but no identifier is named 'Enter at least 1 animal identifier for <species>', with the species name in lower case, and the entry links to that species block (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-059, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-060; c-134)
notes: Depends on the row 'Review reads the commodity selection back in a What are you importing? card…' (the species blocks the table and the error links sit in). Pass 2 combines the table copy, the Change link and the per-species unfinished messages: all are the identification part of a species block. req-879 is the live-animals half only: the 9 October ruling (claim 57) split out the germinal wording (req-1841), which the germinal set's review row builds. These messages are about a missing count or no identifier at all, so the one-identifier rule (claim 188) does not change them.

increments.title: Each uploaded document has its own card on the review, showing its file name
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 gives every uploaded document its own 'Document <n>' card with its own Change link, shows the attached file's name rather than its type, and shows a single 'Not applicable' card when nothing is uploaded. Today all documents share one card.
acceptanceCriteria: Each uploaded document has its own card in '4. Uploaded documents', titled 'Document <n>', whose header Change link opens the documents page, at the address it has today, and on saving returns to the review (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-104, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-105; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-150, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-156; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-077, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-078)

Each document card shows 'Document reference', 'Document type', 'Date of issue' and 'Attachment', where Attachment is the uploaded file's name (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-104; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-150)

With no documents uploaded, '4. Uploaded documents' shows a single 'Document 1' card whose 'Document reference' reads 'Not applicable', and the words 'You have not added any documents yet.' no longer appear (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-106)
notes: Depends on the row 'Review sections and cards take Design Release 2.1's headings, titles and unfinished-card messages' (section 4's name). Kept as its own row because it owns only the documents card and builds in parallel with the other card rows. The tests repo asserts today's empty-state sentence and follows the new card. Virus-scan errors on the review stay (c-140).

increments.title: Addresses card: permanent addresses, CPH format, one header link and a single unfinished entry
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 shows pets' permanent addresses in full in the Addresses card, writes the CPH with slashes, gives the Addresses and Contact address cards one header Change link and no row actions (c-138), returns a CPH change made from the review to the review (c-141, settling DR1 parity row inc-146's open question), and lists one error summary entry per unfinished card, so a deleted saved address is named once, on its card (c-135).
acceptanceCriteria: In the live-animals set, pets' permanent addresses read back in the Addresses card as a 'Permanent address' subsection, one entry per animal labelled '<common name> <n>' (for example 'Domestic cat 1') with the full address and 'United Kingdom', without email or phone, and the identification table has no Permanent address column (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-111; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-152, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-153)
The CPH number reads back with its parts separated by slashes, for example '12/345/6789' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-160, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-154)

No party row and no contact address row carries an 'Edit details' link: the Addresses and Contact address cards' header Change links are their only links (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-067; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-151; c-138)
A party whose copied address breaks the address-book rules still has an error summary entry linking to its edit page (c-138; c-139)

A trader who changes the CPH number from the Addresses card is returned to the review after saving, not sent onward through the journey (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-109, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-110; c-141)

When the consignor's saved address has been deleted, the error summary holds the single entry 'Complete roles and addresses' linking to the Addresses card, and 'Select an address for the consignor' shows on the consignor's row inside the card, with no separate consignor entry in the summary; the full error list for this case is pinned by a test (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-043; c-135)
notes: Depends on the row 'Review sections and cards take Design Release 2.1's headings, titles and unfinished-card messages' (the Addresses and Contact address cards) and on inc-054 as before. Pass 2 combines the Addresses card's read-back slices (permanent addresses, CPH) with its link and error-summary slices (row actions, CPH return, deleted address): all change the same card and its errors. Moving the permanent address out of the identification table touches that table too; the identification row owns the table's other columns. The CPH page's own return behaviour may need the change context the CPH page reads, which is the consignment-parties theme's page: a shared change. The tests repo's page object clicks 'Edit details' today and follows the header link. req-848 is the live-animals set's only: the germinal set's review has no Permanent address subsection and no CPH row (req-1843).

increments.title: The review page reads each party's copied address back as name, address lines and country, in live animals and plants
increments.detail: The trader checks the address copy the notification holds before submitting. Design Release 2.1 reads each consignment party and the contact address back as the name followed by the address lines and the country, each on its own line, with no telephone number or email address. Today the animals review shows each copy as a block with the name in bold and every non-empty field, telephone and email included; plants' check-answers party cards (place of destination, consignor and contact) have Name, Address, Telephone number and Email address rows, with the address joined by commas on one line. The 9 October afternoon ruling (c-293) makes plants change the same way in the same increment. Observable in each frontend's fit suite, on the compose stack and in CDP.
acceptanceCriteria: On the live-animals review page each consignment party with an address reads back as its name, then each non-empty address line, town or city and postcode, then the country, each on its own line (prototype:dr2-1-source p11-065, p11-114; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-160, p12-161, p13-151, p13-155; trace:e2e p8-004, p8-005)
A country of GB reads back as 'United Kingdom' (prototype:dr2-1-source p11-114; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-155)
No party's telephone number or email address appears in the live-animals review page's read-back (trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-160, p13-151; repo:tests p5-040, p5-041)

The contact address for the consignment reads back the same way: name, address lines, country, with no telephone number or email address (prototype:dr2-1-source p11-114; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p13-151; trace:e2e p8-018)

On the plants check-answers page the place of destination, consignor and contact cards have no 'Telephone number' or 'Email address' row (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-031; repo:plantsfrontend p8-024; conflicts:c-293)

On the plants check-answers page each of those cards reads the address back one address line per line, followed by the country on its own line, instead of joined by commas on one line (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-031; repo:plantsfrontend p8-025)
notes: Rewritten for the 9 October afternoon ruling (c-293, req-680 now includes plants): plantsfrontend joins repos, and two plants criteria are added. Plants' d-013 contact telephone and email rows are overruled by c-293 and not cited. The address-book record still carries telephone and email, so plants' single pick still collects them (req-1970, not this area's). Plants' check-answers fit test expects the contact email twice (repo-plantsfrontend p8-059); it changes with the cards. The end-to-end specs that read every copied field back from the review page (copied addresses, submit freeze, address edit) need their review assertions updated to the new read-back. Combiner: the review page and its party cards are the overview-and-review theme's code; plants' check-answers is in no theme yet, so the theme this row keeps must also touch the plants check-answers view-model, or this row moves to a theme that does. Merge with the review-and-submit area's review-card row if one changes the same 'Roles and addresses' or contact cards. Depends on inc-101.

increments.title: Review ends with Continue and Delete, and an amendment's review offers Cancel amend and tells the trader they are re-submitting
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 ends an editable review with Continue and a red Delete. While amending, it adds a 'Cancel amend' button, retitles the review 'Review before re-submitting' once something has changed, and opens with no errors shown. The ruling's validation override still refuses an incomplete resubmission and says why (c-136). The buttons reuse the shared notification actions wording as it reads today. What the delete and cancel-amend confirmations do is the manage-notifications area's.
acceptanceCriteria: An editable journey or draft review ends with 'Continue' and, beside it, a red 'Delete' button that opens the notification's delete confirmation (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-115, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-118; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-162, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-157; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-084; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070)

While a notification is being amended, the review ends with 'Continue', which submits, a secondary 'Cancel amend' button that opens the cancel-amendment confirmation, and a red 'Delete' button that opens the delete confirmation; there is no 'Cancel amendment' link (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-117; c-189)

An amendment's review is headed and titled 'Review your notification' when first opened, and 'Review before re-submitting' once any notification answer differs from the submitted version (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-019)

Changing only the uploaded documents during an amendment leaves the heading 'Review your notification', because only notification answers count as a change (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-019)
An amendment's review opens with no error summary and no card errors, even when answers are missing (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-040, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-041; c-136)
Pressing Continue on an amendment that is not complete does not submit it: the review is shown again with its error summary naming what is missing (c-136)

On a high-risk plants draft's editable check answers, a red warning button with plants' existing 'Delete notification' wording sits beside Continue and opens the notification's delete page; Save and return and the Cancel link stay (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-032; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-044, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-045, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-052)

While a plants notification is being amended, check answers offers 'Cancel amend' as a secondary button beside Continue that opens the cancel-amendment confirmation, in place of the 'Cancel amendment' link under the heading, and shows no delete button (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-032; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-056)

A plants amendment's check answers opens with no error summary and no errors; Continue on an incomplete amendment does not submit it, and the page shown again names what is missing (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-017; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-038, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-040; c-136)
notes: Pass 2 combines the review's end actions with the amendment review's heading and error behaviour: all are the review's own controls and state, with the same amend set-up. The backend already keeps a pre-amend snapshot of the notification separately from its documents; telling the frontend whether the notification answers differ from it is the backend part of this slice. Delete reuses the shared notification actions wording 'Delete' as it reads today; any different wording goes in the review's own copy, never the shared copy (afternoon ruling, claims 69 to 71). The tests repo asserts today that a draft review has no Delete, and the cancel-amend spec uses the 'Cancel amendment' link; both follow. Delete and cancel-amend confirmations belong to manage-notifications; this row only links to them ('Cancel amend' only leads to a confirmation, so it is a link styled as a button, c-189).

req-1991 to req-1993 (plants' review end buttons and amend review) are added here by the combiner, under ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 47. Plants' heading for changed answers is left out: it needs trade-imports-plants-backend, outside the programme (claim 51, deferred.md).

increments.title: A submitted notification's view has a header: reference, status, date submitted and a Back link to the set's own notification list
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 heads a submitted notification's view with its reference and status, dates it, and gives it a Back link. The 9 October ruling keys the header on the real route and the stored status and keeps dashboard draft rows going to the hub; the afternoon ruling sends the Back link, and an unknown notification, to the set's own notification list in the animals frontend (c-143, c-198) and draws the header in the set's own review template with the shared status strip switched off, leaving the shared layout unchanged. This row builds the header for Submitted, Submitted action required and Completed; the draft's own header at the same review route (c-246) is the row after the header actions, because it reuses them. The page title keeps the page name before the service, as accessibility requires (c-006).
acceptanceCriteria: A submitted notification's view shows its notification reference as the h1 in place of 'Review your notification', with its status beside it as a tag reading 'Submitted', and no status strip above it (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-021, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-022; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-179, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-173; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p4-067, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-090; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-096; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-062, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-063)

A submitted notification's view has the page title '<reference> - Import notification service - GOV.UK', while the journey review of a draft or an amendment keeps 'Review your notification - Import notification service - GOV.UK' (trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-173; c-006)

Under the header, a submitted notification's view shows 'Date submitted: <d Month yyyy>', the date it was submitted as stored on the notification (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-023, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-024; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-092, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-102)

A submitted live-animals notification's view has a Back link to the live-animals notification list, the set's own list in the animals frontend (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-016; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-101; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-081; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-015; c-143; c-198)

Opening the view of a notification that does not exist goes to the set's own notification list (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-002, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-007; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-065, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-081; c-198)

A submitted high-risk plants notification's read-only view has the notification reference as its heading, with its status as a tag beside it, in place of 'Check your answers', and no shared status strip above it (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-034, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-062, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-063; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-003, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-051)

That plants view's browser title starts with the notification reference, before the service name (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-034; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-003)

Under its header the plants view shows 'Date submitted: <d Month yyyy>' from the notification's stored submission date (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-034; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-051, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-089)

The plants view's Back link goes to plants' own notification list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-034, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-081; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-005; c-143)
notes: Re-drafted for the 9 October afternoon and templates rulings: the Back link and the missing-notification redirect go to the set's own notification list in the animals frontend (the live-animals set root for live animals; the germinal set's copy of the review points at the germinal set root), replacing the earlier INS front-door destination (c-143, c-198). Because the destination is in the same frontend, every criterion is observable in the fit run, on the workspace stack and in CDP alike, with no configured URL. The header is drawn in the set's own review template with the shared strip switched off (journeyStrip: null); the shared layout is not changed (afternoon ruling, claims 62 to 64). The not-found case stays caught in the review's controller (claim 65). Pass 2 combines the view header (reference, status, title, date submitted) with its navigation (Back link, missing notification): one page state, one set-up. The backend already stores the submitted date but the view data carries only the created date; returning the submitted date is the backend part. Status tags for 'Submitted action required' and 'Submission complete'/'Completed' are the action-required and completed rows'. 'Copy as new', 'Delete' and 'Amend this notification' in the header are the header-actions row's.
req-1995 to req-1998 (plants' submitted view header) are added here by the combiner, under ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 47.
increments.gate: Look at how the page tells a submitted notification's view from the journey review (keyed on the route and stored status), at the view header drawn in the set's own template with the status strip off, and at the Back link to the set's own list: the header-actions, action-required, draft-header and completed rows all build on this header.

increments.title: View header offers Amend, Copy as new and Delete, and shows the import reference numbers as text to copy
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 offers 'Amend this notification' on a submitted notification, 'Copy as new' and 'Delete' on every submitted notification's view, and gives the trader the notification reference and customs document code they need for the customs declaration. Each state-changing control looks as Design Release 2.1 draws it but submits a form with the CSRF token (c-189), and the buttons reuse the shared notification actions wording as it reads today. The 9 October afternoon ruling builds the import reference numbers now as selectable text, without the prototype's JavaScript-only Copy buttons, which wait on design as their own requirement (c-294). What amend, copy and delete do is the manage-notifications area's.
acceptanceCriteria: A Submitted notification's view header shows a primary 'Amend this notification' button, and a draft's review shows none (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-025, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-026; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-097, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-103)

A submitted notification's view header always offers 'Copy as new': a secondary button beside 'Amend this notification' when that shows, otherwise the primary button (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-027; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-098; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070; c-189)

A submitted notification's view header always shows a red 'Delete' warning button that opens the notification's delete confirmation (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-069, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p2-070)

A submitted notification's view shows an 'Import reference numbers' section with the warning 'You must use the correct reference and code on the customs declaration or your consignment will be delayed.', a 'Notification reference' row with the reference and a 'Customs document code' row reading 'C640' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-035, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-036, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-037; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-093, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-094; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-180, trace-prototype-dr2-1-p13-176; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-080; c-294)

Each import reference value is shown as plain text the trader can select and copy, with JavaScript on or off, and neither row shows a 'Copy' button (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-080; c-294)

The header of a submitted plants notification's view shows a primary 'Amend this notification' button (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-035; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-051)

The plants view's header shows the red warning 'Delete notification' button leading to the delete page, which no longer sits at the foot of the view, and the view offers no 'Copy as new' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-035; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-052)

The plants view shows an 'Import reference numbers' section with the warning 'You must use the correct reference and code on the customs declaration or your consignment will be delayed.' and a 'Notification reference' row with the reference as text the trader can select; it has no 'Customs document code' row and no Copy buttons (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-035, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-013; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p8-051, repo-plantsfrontend-p8-087; c-294)

sources.ref: prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-025 to p11-029, p11-035 to p11-038

notes: Depends on the row 'A submitted notification's view has a header…'. Pass 2 combines the header's three action buttons with the import reference numbers section: all sit in the view header under the same set-up. increments.detail: Design Release 2.1's Overview adds only positive counts to the Animals and Packages/boxes totals, so a card never shows a negative or odd total. Held until the reconciler says how such a count could reach the Overview.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Overview, the Animals and Packages/boxes totals add only the positive counts on each commodity line: a zero, negative or non-numeric count adds nothing, and a total that is not above zero reads '0' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-014, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-015; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-010)
openQuestions: Sent back to the reconciler: no trader can enter a zero, negative or non-numeric count (the commodity details page refuses any number of animals or packages below 1, and a template is seeded from the same checked answers), so the change cannot be observed in any environment. The reconciler decides whether req-787 is already met as far as anyone can observe, or names how such a count can reach the Overview.
notes: Drafted by the combiner: the notification-hub drafter listed req-787 as unobservable. It is held here, blocked on the reconciler's answer, so the buildable Overview rows are not held up.

Dropped: the reconciler adopted req-787 as already met (delta exists). Commodity details refuses a number of animals or packages below 1 or not whole, and templates are seeded from the same checked answers, so no zero, negative or non-numeric count can reach the Overview; blank counts already add nothing and both totals already read 0 before any line exists.

increments.title: Amend goes through a confirmation page, then opens the amend review, in animals and plants
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 asks a trader to confirm before amending a submitted notification, then takes them straight to the notification's review page so they can see and change their answers. Today the card's Amend is a form button that starts the amendment straight away and lands on the overview hub, one step away from the review; plants' card Amend does the same. The 9 October afternoon ruling keeps the confirmation as a separate page at the notification's own amend route, carrying the pop-up's wording as page content, with no pop-up (c-190; the pop-up waits on design in its own row). Every way into an amendment goes through it: 'Amend this notification' on the view page and the card's Amend become links to it (c-310), and its 'Yes, continue' is a form post with the CSRF crumb (c-189). Confirming lands on the amend review. An amend that cannot happen returns the trader to the set's own notification list (c-198). Plants gets the same page, landing on plants' own review page, and its refused amend goes to plants' own list. The k6 amendment journey moves with the landing (c-225).
acceptanceCriteria: 'Amend this notification' on a Submitted notification's view page, and Amend on its card in the set's notification list, open a page titled 'Amend notification' with the level-1 heading 'Amend notification' and the question 'Are you sure you want to change this notification?', and the notification stays Submitted until the trader confirms (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-046, prototype-dr2-1-source-p12-047; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-181; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-084; c-190; c-310)

Today the backend copy mapper and the pages disagree: the record clears the internal reference, the species, the unweaned answer and the exit date, yet the copy's overview shows counts, identification, arrival, transit, transport and contact address as Complete because the whole answer payload is copied. c-196 settles that a copy carries exactly Design Release 2.1's list, in the record and on the pages alike, and c-197 that copying an amendment in progress copies its submitted version. After this change a copy keeps and clears what Design Release 2.1 says, and a certified-for value no longer offered is mapped to a current one. Plants has parked Copy as new, so plants is not changed.

increments.title: The INS front door's home becomes the Design Release 2.1 overall dashboard, with the performance suite's readiness probe following its heading
increments.detail: Today the INS front door's root page is a 'Dashboard' table of every notification with a reference search and a sort form. Design Release 2.1 makes the service's home an overall dashboard: a 'Dashboard' caption over the heading 'Import notification service', then one section per notification category, each linking to that category's own notification list in its own frontend (c-145, c-146, c-295). Sam's 9 October rulings block this as INS dashboard summary information until its requirements firm up and are agreed, and the area is then re-distilled. The home's controls (Create new, Use template) and its title go ahead on today's home in their own rows and stay under the heading when this lands. The performance suite only starts a run once the stack is ready, and one of its six readiness probes signs in to the INS home and matches its main heading exactly. Design Release 2.1 changes that heading from 'Dashboard' to 'Import notification service' (c-146). Without this change every performance run would fail readiness after 300 seconds once the heading changes; with it too early, every run fails now. So the probe must change in the same increment that changes the home's heading, which waits with the rest of the overall home.

increments.title: Notification cards show Design Release 2.1's facts and status styles, on the live animals list and on plants' list
increments.detail: The live animals card leads with what is coming, when, to whom and its status: 'Commodity', 'Arrival date', 'Consignee' and 'Notification status', then 'Number of animals', 'Origin' and 'Consignor', read from the animals backend's record. Plants' card takes the same labels, date format, placeholder and status styles with its own facts, keeping its 'Late' tag.

The combiner should consider moving it from the ins-dashboard theme to the theme that owns the live-animals list's feature folder (frontend dashboard), and merging or ordering it with the notification-list area's 'Action required' card row if that area drafts the same tag. increments.title: Action needed drill-down lists the organisation's notifications needing action
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 adds an 'Action needed' page, reached from each category's Action needed card, listing the notifications the trader must act on: a submitted notification still missing a required document, or with no animal identifier where one is required, recorded by the animals backend as 'Submitted action required' (c-149). The INS front door lists those notifications at /actions, across every category or only the one it is showing, scoped to the signed-in organisation, with DR2.1's intro block, a results line, 8 a page and the category list's card (c-154). Sam's 9 October rulings block it as INS dashboard summary information; how the action-required state and the category reach the INS read model is settled when the area is re-distilled.
acceptanceCriteria: The Action needed drill-down is served by the INS front door at /actions with the browser title 'Tasks requiring your attention - Import notification service - GOV.UK', the caption 'Action needed', the h1 'Tasks requiring your attention' and the description 'Add missing information or upload documents to prevent your consignment from being delayed.', laid out in Design Release 2.1's intro block rather than as a GOV.UK caption and heading (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:11708-11710; app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:34-36; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:153-159; conflicts:c-156)

A live-animals notification submitted without its ITAHC or health certificate is listed with an 'Action required' status tag and the message 'ITAHC is missing'; once the certificate is uploaded and the notification re-submitted it is no longer listed (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed action 14-16; trace:e2e p15-087; conflicts:c-149)

A submitted notification with its certificate but a species that needs identifiers and has none identified is listed with 'Information is missing'; once one identifier is filled for each record it is no longer listed (prototype:dr2-1-source p11-149; conflicts:c-149)
A draft notification, and a submitted one with every required document and identifier, are never listed (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14; conflicts:c-149)

A trader signed in for one organisation never sees another organisation's notifications on the drill-down, and a fresh organisation with none sees 'Show 0 of 0 results' (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-068; trace:ins-fit p4-046)

Shown with no category, the drill-down lists action-needed notifications of every category; shown for live animals it lists only live-animals ones, a notification with no stored category counting as live animals; an unrecognised category lists every category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:6745-6747, 9027-9028; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:162-169; conflicts:c-296)

The page's 'Back' link goes to the live animals notification list at the live-animals set root in the animals frontend when it is showing live animals, and to the home when it is showing every category, including for an unrecognised category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:12-24; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:156, 167; conflicts:c-250, c-295)

The list sits under a visually hidden h2 'Notifications needing action', preceded by 'Show 1-8 of <total> results', or 'Show 0 of 0 results' when there are none; with more than 8 the list shows 8 a page, and following a page link keeps the sort and the category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:43-89; app/routes.js:6630-6688, 9050; prototype:dr2-1-specs e2e/dashboard.fit.spec.js:160-161)

Each listed notification shows the same card as the live animals list, with its status tag, its error message and its status-driven links rather than a fixed 'Copy as new' and 'View' pair (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed action 15-16; document:dr1-parity-notes inc-030; conflicts:c-154)

The page shows no 'Create new' or 'Use template' button, no glance cards, no Additional filters, no tabs and no Today / Next 3 days / Already delayed filter, and a delayFilter query changes nothing (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14; prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:9022-9023, 9043-9045)
The service navigation's 'Dashboard' item is marked current on the drill-down (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:8876, 9063; repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-076)

With the front door's stub mode on (never in production), the drill-down lists the built-in stub's notifications; otherwise it reads them from ins-backend, and ins-backend's log for the read carries the page request's trace id (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-062, p1-063)

If the read model cannot be loaded, the drill-down still shows its intro, shows the recoverable error message, responds with HTTP status 500 and logs the failure; with Welsh selected its copy is shown in Welsh, marked as a machine draft; it has no serious or critical axe violations against the WCAG 2.0, 2.1 and 2.2 A and AA tags (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-058, p1-079, p1-086)
openQuestions: Blocked: Sam's 9 October rulings block the INS dashboard's summary information, including the Action needed drill-down (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-059), until its requirements firm up and are agreed; the area is then re-distilled, settling how the action-required state and the category reach the INS read model. Who: whoever owns the INS dashboard's requirements (the rulings do not name them) must firm them up and agree them with Sam.
notes: Re-distil: blocked as summary information. The dependency on the live animals list move (inc-129) is dropped because the list stays in the animals frontend (c-295); the organisation scoping is this row's own (req-1019). The category comes from the animals backend's notification record, absent meaning live animals; how it reaches the read model is the re-distil's to settle (c-296), so the animals backend may join repos then.

Combines the Action needed page, its list rule, the organisation scoping and the read-model request (req-1019, req-1022): the page is the first INS list the home leads to, so they cannot be observed apart.

Depends on the rows that record the action-required state on the animals backend's record (inc-131 for the missing ITAHC, inc-147 for missing identifiers). The germinal products half of req-987's Back rule is observed in the Germinal products section row; the Status updated drill-down's Back link and current navigation item are observed in that blocked row. The Inspection required half of req-990, req-992 and req-994 is proven in that blocked row.
increments.gate: Once unblocked and built, look at what 'Action needed' means in practice before the glance-card counts and the search build on it: which submitted notifications the missing-document and missing-identifier rule lists, the 'Action required' tag and its messages, and that every category filter and Back link lands where it should.

increments.title: Search and sort the Action needed list
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1's Action needed page has a 'Search by' box and a 'Sort by:' select, but the prototype applies neither. A search and sort over real data is behaviour the seeded prototype cannot express, so the real page applies both (c-155): the search matches a notification's number, commodity, consignee or consignor, and the sort is always applied, newest first by default, with no unsorted state (c-157). The form's field and parameter names are the INS service's own. Blocked with the drill-down it searches.
acceptanceCriteria: The Action needed drill-down has a search form on its own page with a 'Search by' field and the hint 'Keyword, notification number, commodity, consignee or consignor'; a search made while it shows only live animals stays within live animals (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:43-87; trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14, action 25; conflicts:c-250)

Searching for part of a listed notification's number, its commodity, its consignee's name or its consignor's name lists only the notifications that match; a search with surrounding spaces finds the same notifications, and a blank search lists them all (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-015; repo:tests repo-tests-p4-081; conflicts:c-155)
A search that matches nothing shows 'Show 0 of 0 results' (prototype:dr2-1-source app/routes.js:7644-7658)

The 'Sort by:' select offers 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', with 'Newest first' selected by default and no 'Select one' option; choosing each and pressing the form's button re-orders the list accordingly, and changing the select alone submits nothing, so the page works without JavaScript (trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed snapshot 14; document:dr1-parity-notes inc-031; conflicts:c-155, c-157)
Page links keep the chosen sort, the search and the category (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-actions.html:43-87; trace:prototype-dr2-1 action-needed action 25)
With Welsh selected, the search label, hint, sort label and options are shown in Welsh, marked as machine drafts (repo:insfrontend repo-insfrontend-p1-086)
openQuestions: Blocked: Sam's 9 October rulings block the INS dashboard's summary information, naming the Action needed drill-down's search and sort (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm p3-059), until its requirements firm up and are agreed; the area is then re-distilled. Who: whoever owns the INS dashboard's requirements (the rulings do not name them) must firm them up and agree them with Sam.
notes: Re-distil: blocked as summary information. Kept apart from the Action needed page row so that row stays reviewable and because this one changes what the read model stores (consignee and consignor) and how it searches.
The same search form, sort select and results line are reused by the blocked Inspection required drill-down, which proves its own half of req-990, req-992 and req-994.

A notification whose record carries no category is counted in the Live animals Action needed card (conflicts:c-296)
The Live animals section shows no Inspection required card (prototype:dr2-1-source app/views/design-release-2.1/dashboard-home.html:57-70; trace:prototype-dr2-1 overall-dashboard action 30)

increments.title: The live animals list has 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed' tabs
increments.detail: The live animals list separates work in flight, unfinished drafts and finished notifications with three tabs built as MoJ sub navigation links. 'In progress' is the default and the only tab with a count; a notification being amended stays in 'In progress' with its 'Amending' tag. The animals backend's list API gains the category and tab filters and the 'In progress' count the tabs need.
acceptanceCriteria: The live animals list has three tabs, 'In progress', 'Draft' and 'Completed', built as MoJ sub navigation, each a link that loads the page with that tab chosen, with or without JavaScript; 'In progress' is the list with no tab chosen, and a missing or unknown tab shows 'In progress'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037, prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-061; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-042; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-103, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-105; conflict c-251, c-299)

Following a tab drops the search and sort: the chosen tab shows its notifications unsearched, in the default order. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-038-m1; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-081)

'In progress' lists the organisation's submitted and action-required notifications and its notifications being amended, each amending one with its yellow 'Amending' tag and Resume, 'Copy as new', 'Cancel amendment' and Delete; it lists no draft. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-039; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-073; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-046, repo-frontend-p3-111; conflict c-165)

'Draft' lists only drafts, and 'Completed' lists no draft, submitted, action-required or amending notification. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-039; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-075)

Only 'In progress' shows a count, in bold brackets, such as 'In progress (2)', counting the notifications that tab lists; 'Draft' and 'Completed' show no count, even when selected. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-037; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-062; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-043)

Under the tabs the cards sit under an h3 naming the tab: 'Notifications in progress', 'Draft notifications' or 'Completed notifications'. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p13-040; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-063; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-044, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-055, prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-057)

The animals backend's list API filters by category (live animals or germinal products, a record with no category counting as live animals) and by tab (the in-progress statuses, drafts, or completed), and reports how many notifications the 'In progress' tab holds for that category; asked for germinal products, it returns none of the organisation's live animals notifications. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-066, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-073; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-013; conflict c-159)

increments.title: The live animals list's search and sort become one form that really searches and sorts
increments.detail: The live animals list's search and sort move into one column above the tabs, in one GET form submitted by an icon-only search button. The search matches part of a reference, commodity, consignee or consignor in any case, and the sort offers 'Newest first', 'Oldest first' and 'Arrival date', applied for real and stable across pages. The animals backend's list API does the matching and the ordering.

(trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p1-045; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p3-009, repo-frontend-p3-010; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-073; conflict c-167)

increments.title: Identifier-driven outstanding items: warnings, inline error, confirmation bullet and the list's 'Information is missing'
increments.detail: Design Release 2.1 treats incomplete animal identifiers as an outstanding item: it names them in the action-required warnings, marks the species inline, adds a confirmation bullet and shows 'Information is missing' on the dashboard card. The 9 October ruling closes DR1 inc-103 (one identifier is enough to identify an animal record) and removes this row's blocker (c-133); the afternoon ruling builds the list message on the set's own notification list in the animals frontend. Identifiers are incomplete when a commodity line whose species asks for identifiers holds fewer identified animal records than the animals it declares, which includes a single-species consignment with no identifier saved.
acceptanceCriteria: A notification that meets the submission minimum, but has a commodity line whose species asks for identifiers holding fewer identified animal records than the animals it declares, is submitted with the outstanding item 'complete the animal identifier information in the notification', shown on the confirmation page (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-147; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-193; c-133)
A single-species consignment submitted with no identifier saved gets the same outstanding item on the confirmation page (c-133; prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-147)

An animal record with one identifier filled counts as identified, so a notification whose every declared animal has a record with one identifier filled gets no identifier outstanding item (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-188, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-191)

An action-required notification missing both animal identifiers and its ITAHC shows the header warning 'You need to complete animal identifiers and upload a health certificate' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-031, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-034)

An action-required notification missing only animal identifiers shows the header warning 'You need to complete animal identifiers' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-032, prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-034)

On an action-required notification, a species that needs identifiers but has none shows 'Identification details' with the inline error 'Enter a minimum of 1 identifier' in place of its content, inline with no error summary (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-090; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p5-099)

On the live-animals notification list, a submitted notification with its ITAHC but incomplete identifiers shows the error 'Information is missing' on its card (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p11-149; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-066, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-075; c-149)
notes: Re-drafted for the 9 October afternoon ruling (claims 66 and 75): the 'Information is missing' message is built on the animals frontend's own list, so insbackend and insfrontend leave this row's repos; the combiner should move it with the 'Action required on the set's own notification list' row (inc-131) out of the ins-dashboard theme. The same identified-record count decides submit and the hub's Complete status (claim 189); this row adds no stricter bar. Pass 2 keeps all five identifier-driven items together: one rule, worked out once at submission, read back on four surfaces.

Theme moved to animals-dashboard: the notification list stays in the animals frontend and is reframed in place, with plants' list in the same increment (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claims 54 and 55; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claim 3).

increments.title: The stub's countries and ports match real MDM, and every captured country and port fixture is recaptured from it
increments.detail: The 9 October ruling's stub tidy-up, countries half: trade-imports-stub's MDM countries fixture is regenerated from MDM's raw responses, all 250 countries in MDM's order with their full real records, served whole, and filtered by the blocks parameter as MDM does. The animals frontend, the high-risk plants frontend, the INS frontend and the tests repo then recapture or derive their country data from what reference data now serves, so every later list row is built and tested against what MDM really serves. Sam's 9 October ruling accepts a stub tidy-up so the stub matches real MDM, ahead of the list rows that assert port names and counts. Today the stub's ports are 78 hand-kept Great Britain ports carrying only an id, a code and a name, and the stub drops any field its models do not know. After this change the stub serves MDM's real port records, whole and in MDM's order, each with its traffic, so the port type reaches reference data locally and in CDP dev as it does from real MDM. The animals frontend's and the plants frontend's captured ports fixtures are recaptured from it, so every later list row is built and tested against what MDM really serves. MDM's duplicate and misspelt ports stay: they are MDM's content, reported to the MDM team, and no test pins them.
acceptanceCriteria: Locally and in CDP dev, the stub's MDM countries call without a blocks filter answers all 250 countries in MDM's order with their full real records, in place of today's 31 hand-kept records, and no value MDM masks is filled in (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-147, p1-150, p1-152, p1-153; repo:stub repo-stub-p2-011, repo-stub-p2-047)

Locally and in CDP dev, the stub's countries call for the GBNAG_SPS_EX block answers the 32 countries in that block, as MDM does (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-155; repo:stub repo-stub-p2-005, repo-stub-p2-043, repo-stub-p2-079)
Locally and in CDP dev, the stub serves each country record whole, including fields its own models do not name (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-154; repo:stub repo-stub-p2-008, repo-stub-p2-046)

The stub's own tests check the regenerated countries fixture, and check that the blocks filter answers 32 countries for GBNAG_SPS_EX and 250 without it (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-156; repo:stub repo-stub-p2-069, repo-stub-p2-070, repo-stub-p2-074)

In the animals frontend's stub mode, the country of origin list offers the same countries, names and order as reference data serves from the tidied stub, and no country check is marked as waiting on an endpoint that is not built (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-157, p1-158; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-077; trace:animals-fit trace-animals-fit-p5-016)

increments.title: A germinal products notification starts in its own set, with its own draft, stored category, service chrome and origin page, and each set opens only its own notifications
increments.detail: Germinal products is a sibling set of live animals and both keep their notifications in the one animals backend, so the stored record must say which set it belongs to. The backend's create takes the category each set sends and stores it at the root of the record beside its status and reference; nothing after create changes it, and a record with no category is read as live animals, so every notification stored before the germinal set exists stays a live-animals notification without a data migration. The read the frontend opens a notification with returns the category, so each set's cross-set guard can refuse the other set's notifications. The category stays on the record only: it is not published on any notification event, and the event envelope does not change. Sam's 9 October ruling makes germinal products (semen, embryos and ova) a sibling set of live animals in the animals frontend, mounted at /germinal-products with its own journey, flow, obligations, cookies, gateway and set services, its pages copied from the finished live-animals feature folders plus the germinal differences. This row lays that set down and proves it with its first page: a trader who chooses Germinal products on the type question gets a new Draft notification with a GBN-AG reference and lands on the germinal set's own copy of the origin page. The germinal set's end-to-end, accessibility and security checks run inside the existing animals Playwright project. The live-animals set creates each draft with the category live animals and the germinal products set with the category germinal products, so each notification reaches its own set's list. A record with no category still counts as live animals, so older drafts stay on the live animals list. This is this area's share of the germinal set's first row, inc-176, which builds the category on the stored record. Sam's 9 October ruling keeps one category per set: a germinal products notification can only be worked in the germinal set, and a live-animals notification only in the live-animals set. Each set's entry guard reads the category recorded on the notification when its draft was created, and a notification with no recorded category is treated as live animals. Germinal products is its own sibling set beside live animals in the animals frontend, mounted at /germinal-products. Its pages carry the same chrome as live animals: the 'Import notification service' service navigation, the Alpha phase banner, the footer, the GOV.UK title pattern, section captions, back links, error summary and banners. The set-scoped parts resolve inside the germinal set: the service name and the Dashboard item go to the germinal set's own home, which is the set's own notification list (not a hand-off to the INS frontend), Dashboard stays current inside a germinal notification, and an error under /germinal-products is shown in the germinal set's chrome. The shared layout already resolves these per set, so this is mostly proof that the germinal set picks them up.
acceptanceCriteria: A draft the germinal products set creates is stored with the category germinal products, and a draft the live-animals set creates is stored with the category live animals, beside the record's status and reference. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029, -p1-030; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-093; repo:backend repo-backend-p1-001, repo-backend-p1-002, repo-backend-p2-001)

A notification stored before this change, with no category on its record, is read as live animals: it still opens, saves and submits in the live-animals set, with no data migration. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-029; repo:backend repo-backend-p1-002)

Saving, submitting, amending, cancelling an amendment and copying a notification never change its stored category; a copy of a germinal products notification is a germinal products notification. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-023, -p1-030; repo:backend repo-backend-p2-001)

A notification holds commodities of its one category only: changing the type from a live-animals draft starts a new notification of the other category, and the abandoned draft keeps its stored category live animals. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-025, -p1-054, -p1-055, -p1-056)

The read the animals frontend opens a notification with returns its stored category, and live animals for a record with none, so opening a germinal products notification through a live-animals page, or a live-animals notification through a germinal products page, shows the page not found page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-031; repo:backend repo-backend-p3-019; repo:perftests repo-perftests-p1-075)

The outbox events published for a germinal products notification have the same envelope as a live-animals notification's, with no category property, and the event envelope schema in trade-imports-schemas is unchanged. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-092, -p3-093, -p3-094; repo:tests repo-tests-p3-200; conflict c-272)

Choosing 'Germinal products' on the type question 'What are you importing?' creates a new notification with status Draft and a reference of the form GBN-AG-<two-digit year>-<six characters>, shown in the status strip from the first page, and lands on the germinal products set's 'Origin of the import' page under /germinal-products/notifications/. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-027, -p1-048; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-091; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p3-055)
No germinal products notification is ever given a reference starting GBN-GP. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-028)

The germinal origin page asks the same questions, with the same heading, hints, options and error messages, as the finished live-animals origin page, and saves its answers to the germinal notification: every live-animal field V4 does not mark animals-only is carried over. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011, -p1-013, -p1-015; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-001-m1, -p1-005, -p1-047)

The germinal set's end-to-end, accessibility and security checks run in the existing animals Playwright project, with no new project: the accessibility checks hold each germinal page to WCAG 2.2 AA on first load and with answers filled, under the suite's existing axe rules, and the security scan drives the germinal pages. Opening a germinal products notification through a live-animals page shows the page not found page and changes nothing. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-023, p1-031; repo:frontend p1-092, p1-134)
Opening a live-animals notification through a germinal products page shows the page not found page and changes nothing. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-023, p1-031)
A notification stored with no category opens in the live-animals set and shows the page not found page in the germinal products set. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-029, p1-030)

Every germinal products page shows the 'Import notification service' service navigation with the same items, in the same order, as a live-animals page shown at the same time (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates ruling-sam-2026-10-09-templates-p1-012; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-006, repo-frontend-p1-010)

Every germinal products page's browser title reads '<page title> - Import notification service - GOV.UK', with 'Error: ' in front when the page shows validation errors (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-006)

Germinal products journey pages show the same section captions, back links, error summary and banners as the live-animals page they are copied from (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011)

On every germinal products page, the service name and the Dashboard item lead to the germinal set's own home, never to the live-animals home or the INS frontend (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-086; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-006, repo-frontend-p1-010; conflicts:c-314)

Dashboard is the current navigation item on the germinal set's home and on every page inside a germinal products notification (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-011; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011)

Opening an address under /germinal-products that does not exist shows 'Page not found' in the germinal set's chrome, with the service name leading to the germinal set's home (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p1-048-m1; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008)

increments.title: Germinal Commodity details checks weight and packages, listing errors by question
increments.detail: V4 caps the germinal total gross weight at 1,000 kg to 2 decimal places and above 0, and makes the quantity mandatory to proceed, up to 1,000. Design Release 2.1 counts packages in whole numbers from 1 and gives the messages it has; the rest follow the GOV.UK pattern. Valid answers continue as the journey says. Design Release 2.1 orders the Commodity details error summary by question. Ruling 2026-10-09 splits that per set; on the germinal set every total gross weight error comes before every number of packages error. The V4 germinal data fields make temperature optional, so temperature raises no error and never appears in the summary.
acceptanceCriteria: A Total gross weight that is not a number greater than 0 (digits with an optional decimal part, no sign, commas or units), such as 0, shows 'Enter a number greater than 0', linked from the error summary to that species' field and shown inline. (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p3-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p5-039; prototype:dr2-1-specs prototype-dr2-1-specs-p2-036; confluence:6497338582 confluence-6497338582-p1-008)

A Total gross weight of 1.5 or 24.50 is accepted; one with more than 2 decimal places, such as 1.555, shows 'Total gross weight must have 2 decimal places or fewer', linked to that species' field and shown inline. increments.title: Germinal products roles and addresses page and party pickers, with no CPH number or permanent address page
increments.detail: Gives the germinal products set its own roles and addresses page and its own five party pickers, copied from the live-animals addresses feature once this area's rows have built it, as ruling sam-2026-10-09 directs (germinal products is a sibling set of duplicated feature pages). The copy behaves as the live-animals page and pickers do, with the same words and hints, except that a germinal consignment is only ever asked for the five consignment addresses: the set has no CPH number and no permanent address section, and serves no CPH number or permanent address page. A trader importing germinal products can then record every party of the consignment within the germinal notification. Germinal products are not kept on a holding and are not pets, so the germinal products set, copied from the live-animals addresses feature, must leave out the CPH number and permanent address sections and pages the live set has. On a germinal products notification, section 'Consignment parties' of the Overview holds the single row 'Roles and addresses' with the same hint as live animals, and the row covers the consignment addresses only: the germinal set has no CPH number or permanent address page, so the row reads 'Complete' once the addresses are complete.
acceptanceCriteria: From a germinal products notification's overview, the 'Roles and addresses' task opens a 'Consignment addresses' page with the caption 'Consignment parties', the paragraph 'Add all the addresses that are involved in the consignment.' and the warning 'Providing a false address is an act of fraud', within that germinal products notification (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122)

For every germinal commodity the page shows exactly five sections, in this order: Place of origin, Consignor, Consignee, Importer, Place of destination; it shows no CPH number section and no 'Permanent address' section (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-057)

The germinal products set offers no CPH number page and no permanent address page: nothing on its pages links to one, and opening either page's address under a germinal products notification shows 'Page not found' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

Each section's hint reads as on the live-animals page, word for word, including Place of origin 'The address where the animals begin their journey to Great Britain' and Place of destination 'This is where the animals will be unloaded and accommodated for at least 48 hours. If a health certificate is required, it will show this address.' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-122-m1; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-046)

Each empty row's link ('Add a place of origin', 'Add a consignor', 'Add a consignee', 'Add an importer', 'Add a place of destination') opens the germinal set's own picker for that party; choosing an address there and pressing 'Save and continue' returns to the germinal page, which shows the full address with a 'Change' link, and the address is saved on the germinal products notification only (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p9-001)

The germinal pickers offer the same addresses for each role, on one page, with the same server search, place of origin country search, 'View' link, results count and blank-save behaviour as the live-animals pickers; 'Add a new address' shows as a secondary button beside the heading on the compose stack and is left out in stub mode (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-013, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

The germinal page offers the same-as buttons ('Same as place of origin' on Consignor; 'Same as consignee' on Importer and Place of destination) under the same rules as the live-animals page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-014)

The germinal overview's 'Roles and addresses' task shows Complete once all five parties have an address, with no CPH number or permanent address asked for (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p8-014; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-017, ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-018)

Nothing in the germinal products set links to, asks for or serves a CPH number or an animal's permanent address: opening either page's address under a germinal products notification shows 'Page not found' (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-006, p1-014, p1-017, p1-018, p1-025)

On the germinal Overview, section 'Consignment parties' holds the single row 'Roles and addresses' with the hint 'Consignor or Exporter, Consignee, Importer and Place of Destination' (prototype:dr2-1-source p12-034, p12-035; trace:prototype-dr2-1 p12-152)

increments.title: The rest of the germinal journey in the live-animals step order: arrival, transit countries, contact address, declaration and submission, certified for 'Germinal products'
increments.detail: The germinal products set follows the same Design Release 2.1 step order, opening run, return rules, shared journey buttons and status strip as the live-animals set, taken from copies of the live-animals pages once this programme has changed them, except that the additional details, CPH number and permanent address steps never apply. The certified-for answer is set to 'Germinal products' when the draft is created, so nothing asks it. The germinal products set never asks what the goods are certified for: a draft is created with 'Germinal products' already stored, published as the GOODS_CERTIFIED_AS declaration clause like any other certified-for answer, and read back on the review with no Change link. On a germinal products notification, the Overview shows 'Transit countries' in section 3 when transit countries are required, as Design Release 2.1 shows for germinal products, and the task reads 'Complete' once a transit country is chosen. The rule for when they are required belongs to the arrival-and-transit area; the task needs the germinal set's own Transit countries page.
acceptanceCriteria: In a new germinal products notification's opening run, 'Save and continue' carries the trader through the pages in the live-animals run's order, going from 'Identification details' (when it applies) or 'Commodity details' straight to 'Arrival details', and from the contact address page to the review page. Every germinal journey page shows the status strip with the notification's GBN-AG reference and status, and ends with the same journey buttons as its live-animals page. (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 p1-011, p1-014, p1-086)

A newly created germinal-products notification's review shows an Additional details block with one row, 'Certified for', reading 'Germinal products', before any journey page has been answered (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-019; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p12-079)

increments.title: The germinal set has no Additional details step, and a germinal species counts as identified once it has one identifier
increments.detail: The germinal set leaves out the Additional details page: its overview has no Additional details task, and a valid identification page reached through the journey goes straight to Arrival details. Every germinal identification field is optional on its own, but V4 needs at least one germinal identifier: every selected germinal species, a lone species included, counts as identified, for the overview's Complete status and for submit, once its entry holds at least one of the four.

increments.title: Germinal products templates are answered on the germinal set's pages, and the germinal origin page's Back link follows where the notification started
increments.detail: A germinal products template is answered on the germinal set's own question pages in template mode, so it never asks additional details, a CPH number or a permanent address. It is saved, listed with the category 'Germinal products', viewed, changed and deleted like any template, and using it starts a germinal products notification seeded with the answers that fit the germinal set. In the germinal products set, the origin page's Back link goes to the notification type question when the notification was started from it, to the germinal products set's own notifications list when started from that list, to the notification overview when opened from the overview, and to the template review when a germinal products template is being edited. This is the germinal half of the origin Back link (the 9 October ruling split req-013 by set).
acceptanceCriteria: Choosing Germinal products on the type question in template creation, then naming the template, opens the germinal set's origin page in template mode with the 'Template' caption and name; the template's task list has no Additional details task and it asks no CPH number or permanent address (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 16-18, 127; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-templates claims 26-30)

A saved germinal products template is listed on Manage templates with the category 'Germinal products', and is viewed, changed and deleted like any template (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 51; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p15-066; c-266)

Pressing 'Use template' on a germinal products template starts a germinal products draft notification in the germinal set, with a GBN-AG reference, and opens the germinal set's task list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 6, 51; c-266; c-309)

Using a germinal products template seeds the main reason for import, the purpose in the internal market only when the reason is 'Internal market', and the storage temperature only when it is one of the germinal products temperature options (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p14-067, p14-069; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 21)
